name: HydroSuite Example Edition
description: HydroSuite Example Edition is a commercial modelling suite for water utilities, bundling a drinking water network solver, a sewer and stormwater engine and a flood inundation module behind one graphical interface with GIS import and scenario management. It is sold by Example Hydraulics Ltd, a software vendor, to utilities and consultancies for master planning and operational studies. The suite is location-independent and used in several countries; models are built from the customer's own network data. It is a desktop Windows application with an optional cloud runner; pricing is by annual subscription on request, and a free student edition with a node limit exists. Caveats: file formats are proprietary, documentation is available only to licensees, and there is no public API, so coupling with other tools relies on export to CSV. Interfaces are GUI and a scripting console; deployment is desktop and cloud. Simulation uses include network flow, capacity planning and emergency response for the water sector as a whole. It relates to the Example Pipe Fragility Library, whose functions can be applied to its network exports.
access_note: Quotation on request; student edition free with node limit.
